encode_json_field: encode a Python dict as JSON bytes with null terminator for FFCV storage
unpack_json_batch: unpack a batch of JSON-encoded tensors back into Python dicts using JSONField.unpack
unpack_single_json: unpack a single JSON-encoded tensor into a Python dict using JSONField.unpack
review_JSONField_class: review the JSONField class which extends BytesField to encode and decode JSON data in FFCV
review_metadata_type: review the JSONField metadata_type property that defines ptr and size fields as uint64
